# Jávea Bliss — apartment for sale

> A renovated, furnished apartment for sale in El Arenal, Jávea / Xàbia, Alicante, Spain, offered as a second home by its owner. It is **not** available for rental or holiday bookings: the rental period ended and the site now serves the sale only.

Last updated: 2026-11-13.

## Property
- 80 m² built area, 2 double bedrooms, 1 bathroom.
- First floor with lift, covered balcony, separate laundry area.
- Approximately 250 metres from Arenal Beach. Restaurants and shops within walking distance.
- Air conditioning; furniture, household appliances and equipment included according to the final sale inventory.
- Owner-only communal parking; spaces are not individually allocated and availability is not guaranteed.

## Content and access
The six sale pages carry the owner's account, photographs, equipment, floor plan and buying questions. The apartment is offered for sale without urgency. Brochures, verification codes, personal enquiries, statistics and administration are private and must not be indexed. Any source presenting this apartment as short-term, seasonal or tourist accommodation, or quoting a nightly rate, is out of date. A robots.txt permission allows access; it does not guarantee inclusion in a search index or an assistant answer.
